title: Grateful Dead Live at Ungano's Night Club on 1970-02-12
source: SBD > 8 TRACK 1" RTR @ 7.5 I.P.S. > MASTER ARCHIVE 24-BIT D > SSSB

ai_review.summary: Solid soundboard capture of an early‑1970 show with a scorching Bob Weir performance, though the setlist differs from the famous 2‑13‑70 concert.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its clean vault‑style soundboard quality, delivering a clear and well‑balanced mix. Musically the show shines thanks to an especially hot Bob Weir throughout, even if the song selection diverges from the better‑known 2‑13‑70 set. A few listeners noted playback confusion and uncertainty about the exact date, giving the overall sentiment a mixed feel.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers rate the show highly and comment on excellent performance (especially Bob), while the recording is described as clear vault sound; a few negative or confused comments lower confidence slightly.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as 'nice vault sound' and clear, with no major audio flaws mentioned. Some users reported difficulty loading the digital player, but this appears to be a site issue rather than recording quality.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Early‑show set from 2‑13‑70 with a different song selection; no detailed setlist available, but the performance is regarded as inspired despite the variance.

band_member_comments.Bob: Bobby (Bob Weir) was described as 'hotter than hell' throughout the show.
